source.check: deemed re-elected (no nomination): retiring member named by the source as returned without a poll (Larne Times, 10 May 1930, p. 8 ("Larne nominations: Guardians and Council"), image-read)

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930. The Larne Times nomination-day report prints the 16 retiring members by division and the nominations: contests in Glenarm North, Glencloy and Glynn; nine divisions with a single nominee; no nominations for Ballycorr, Cairncastle, Kilwaughter and Templecorran, whose retiring members were deemed re-elected. No nomination received (LT 10 May 1930 p8); the retiring member, named in the same report's list of members at the dissolution, deemed re-elected. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
